item.title: Apple’s ANC AirPods 4 with 2-yrs. of AppleCare+ now at $118 via Amazon (Reg. $208, all-time low)
item.description: One of the best and most compelling deals we featured across all of Black Friday and Cyber Monday this year was AirPods 4 with ANC down at $99 shipped. That’s an insane 45% off and, perhaps even more miraculously, it is still live right now at the time of writing. But if you’re looking for some extra coverage on your pickup, Amazon is also offering an equally as wild deal on AirPods 4 with ANC and 2-year of Apple Care+ protection down at $118 shipped– that’s $90 off. more…

item.title: Samsung now offering big-time $400 cash discount on all Galaxy Tab S10 Ultra configs
item.description: Yesterday we feared a notable deal on Galaxy Tab S11/Ultra as part of the ongoing Samsung Cyber Week sale. You can land its latest flagship tablet release at $200 off with a FREE official keyboard case thrown in – that’s a seriously notable offer. But we also wanted to highlight the deep price drop live on the still more than compelling Galaxy Tab S10 Ultra – all configurations are seeing straight up $400 discounts right now with no strings attached. more…

item.title: Amazon’s full-size Echo Show 15 and 21 smart displays return to Black Friday pricing today
item.description: While much of the Black Friday and Cyber Monday deals on Amazon’s in-house Echo tech have come and gone now, we are getting surprise return lows on the super-sized Amazon Echo Show 15 and 21 smart displays this morning. Some of the more rarely discounted releases in the current-generation lineup, Amazon has decided to bring back holiday pricing on both sizes as of this morning. more…

item.title: Best Buy Holiday Deals of the Day: 4K Smart Fire TV $150, 50% off Windows laptop, Alienware monitor, more
item.description: Best Buy, as you probably already know, is continuing to keep the deals rolling for the holiday season, and it’s offering new deals every day as part of its Deals of the Day offers. It’s a pretty big lineup today with offers on Alienware’s curved gaming monitors, Smart TVs, home appliances, and more. Today’s deals are now live over at the landing page right here, and we’ve highlighted some of our favorites along with more details below. more…

item.title: Add Apple’s latest black Alpine Loop to your Natural Ultra 2/3 at a new all-time low today
item.description: If you bought your Natural Apple Watch Ultra 2 or Ultra 3 with one of the deals from Amazon, Best Buy or something along those lines, you did not get a chance to score it with Apple’s official black Alpine Loop – these retailers just don’t carry that configuration. However, this morning Amazon dropped the official black Alpine Loop with the Natural titanium finish down to a new all-time low if you’re looking to bring one into your collection. more…
